subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Treatment Outcomes and Clinical Trials
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and real-world studies evaluating treatments for localized, metastatic, and castration-resistant prostate cancer, including androgen deprivation therapy, enzalutamide, abiraterone, cabazitaxel, radiotherapy, and surgical approaches such as radical prostatectomy. Focuses on survival endpoints, functional outcomes, and treatment sequencing.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Molecular Biology and Genomics
subtopics.description: Molecular, genomic, and epigenomic studies of prostate cancer including androgen receptor signaling, chromatin remodeling, neuroendocrine differentiation, lineage plasticity, lipid metabolism, and driver mutations such as SPOP, BRCA2, and RB1. Encompasses transcriptomic profiling, single-cell analyses, and identification of therapeutic vulnerabilities.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Imaging, Biopsy, and Diagnostic Tools
subtopics.description: Studies on multiparametric MRI, PSMA PET/CT, AI-assisted image analysis, and biopsy techniques (transperineal vs. transrectal, MRI-targeted) for detection and characterization of clinically significant prostate cancer. Includes radiomics, deep learning classifiers, and prebiopsy MRI impact on pathological concordance.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Screening, Surveillance, and Health Disparities
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and health services research on PSA screening trends, active surveillance utilization, racial and ethnic disparities in prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment, and sociodemographic factors influencing management of localized prostate cancer. Includes studies on USPSTF guideline impacts and genomic testing in clinical decision-making.

subtopics.label: PSMA-Targeted Theranostics and Radiopharmaceuticals in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Preclinical and clinical research on PSMA-targeted imaging agents and radioligand therapies including 177Lu-PSMA-617, 177Lu-J591, 177Lu-rhPSMA-10.1, and 64Cu/67Cu-based ligands for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Covers dosimetry, safety analyses, and theranostic strategies.

subtopics.label: Bladder and Urothelial Cancer: Treatment, Genomics, and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Clinical and translational research on bladder cancer and urothelial carcinoma including immunotherapy (atezolizumab, pembrolizumab, epacadostat), antibody-drug conjugates (sacituzumab govitecan), neoadjuvant chemotherapy, FGFR-targeted therapy, genomic evolution (APOBEC mutagenesis, ecDNA), and surgical outcomes of radical cystectomy. Encompasses upper tract urothelial carcinoma and muscle-invasive disease.

subtopics.label: Renal Cell Carcinoma: Systemic Therapy, Genomics, and Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Research on clear cell and other subtypes of renal cell carcinoma covering systemic therapies (pazopanib, immune checkpoint inhibitors, RAS inhibitors), molecular biology (ATF4/ISR, NDUFA4L2, metabolic remodeling), genomic landscape after treatment, liquid biopsy, and surgical approaches including nephrectomy and ablative techniques.

subtopics.label: Kidney Stones, Endourology, and Percutaneous Procedures
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on kidney stone management including percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PCNL), retrograde intrarenal surgery with laser lithotripsy, ureteroscopy practice patterns, spontaneous stone passage prediction, and 24-hour urine collection in high-risk stone formers. Includes imaging modalities for stone detection.

subtopics.label: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia and Functional Urology
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and minimally invasive treatments for benign prostatic hyperplasia (TURP, PUL, water vapor thermal therapy), ureteral stent management, stress urinary incontinence surgery including sling mesh implants, pelvic floor disorders, and urologic chronic pelvic pain syndrome (UCPPS) including bladder hyperalgesia and pelvic floor muscle tenderness.

subtopics.label: Male Infertility, Spermatology, and Reproductive Medicine
subtopics.description: Clinical and basic science research on male infertility including semen analysis trends, varicocelectomy outcomes, azoospermia genetics, sperm chromatin fragmentation, vasectomy reversal, testicular torsion, and assisted reproductive technology outcomes. Encompasses sperm capacitation biology, spermatogenesis regulation, and novel reproductive techniques.

subtopics.label: Non-Hormonal Male Contraception and Sperm Signaling Biology
subtopics.description: Basic and translational research on soluble adenylyl cyclase (sAC/ADCY10) as a target for on-demand non-hormonal male contraception, including inhibitor design, pharmacological evaluation, sperm motility rescue with cAMP analogs, and characterization of sAC-null sperm. Covers sperm metabolic changes during capacitation.

subtopics.label: Penile, Erectile, and Prosthetic Urology
subtopics.description: Clinical research on erectile dysfunction management including intracavernosal injection therapy, inflatable penile prosthesis surgery (complications, antibiotic prophylaxis, concurrent incontinence surgery), Peyronie's disease treatment with collagenase, and penile cancer surgical outcomes. Includes post-prostatectomy sexual function and erectile dysfunction after colorectal surgery.

subtopics.label: Urothelial Carcinoma Cytopathology and Pathological Diagnosis
subtopics.description: Studies on cytological and histopathological diagnosis of urothelial carcinoma including The Paris System quantitation criteria, nuclear hypochromasia in high-grade urothelial carcinoma, morphologic variance by anatomical location, Z-stack imaging for whole slide images, and ancillary immunohistochemical markers such as SPINK1 for urothelial dysplasia and carcinoma in situ.

subtopics.label: Urinary Tract Infections, Microbiome, and Infectious Complications
subtopics.description: Research on urinary tract infection pathogenesis, diagnosis, and prevention including the role of gut microbiota in UTI risk, Ureaplasma/Mycoplasma in recurrent UTIs, Enterococcus virulence, bacteriophage therapy post-transplant, procalcitonin diagnostic accuracy, and infectious complications of urological procedures.

subtopics.label: Prostate and Urological Cancer Biomarkers and Liquid Biopsy
subtopics.description: Translational studies on circulating tumor DNA, cell-free DNA methylation, plasma metabolomics, ctDNA serial monitoring, and tissue-based genomic biomarkers for prostate, renal, and urothelial cancers. Includes polygenic risk scores, tumor mutational burden, and multi-analyte approaches for early detection, risk stratification, and treatment response monitoring.
